description: Environment setup: Install all dependencies across all three layers and verify baseline builds/tests pass.
steps: Install Python 3.11 dependencies: cd apps/backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && pip install pytest pytest-asyncio pytest-cov pytest-env
Install pnpm workspace dependencies: cd /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya && pnpm install
Run backend pytest: cd apps/backend && APP_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=test-secret-at-least-32-characters-long pytest tests/ -v --tb=short 2>&1 | tee /tmp/backend-test-results.txt
Run edge TypeScript check: cd apps/edge && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/edge-tsc-results.txt
Run edge vitest: cd apps/edge && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tee /tmp/edge-test-results.txt
Run frontend vite build: cd apps/frontend && npx vite build 2>&1 | tee /tmp/frontend-build-results.txt
Run frontend vitest: cd apps/frontend && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tee /tmp/frontend-test-results.txt
Create a summary report file at /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya/AUDIT_BUILD_VERIFICATION.md with the results of all build and test steps, noting any failures, warnings, or errors encountered.
acceptance_criteria: All three layers have dependencies installed successfully
Backend pytest runs (pass or fail with documented reasons)
Edge tsc --noEmit runs (pass or fail with documented reasons)
Edge vitest runs (pass or fail with documented reasons)
Frontend vite build runs (pass or fail with documented reasons)
Frontend vitest runs (pass or fail with documented reasons)
A summary report AUDIT_BUILD_VERIFICATION.md exists documenting all results
verification: cat /projects/sandbox/-kalukaliya/AUDIT_BUILD_VERIFICATION.md to confirm it was created with build/test results
findings: All deps installed and builds pass. Backend: 244/244 tests pass. Edge: 75/77 pass (2 pre-existing failures in api-proxy and edge-caching tests - expectation drift). Frontend: vite build succeeds; 579/584 tests pass (5 pre-existing failures in AdminHealth.credits.test.jsx - component renders AWS panel where tests expect GCP credits content). Python 3.11 is required for backend requirements.txt.
